name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (国家企业信用信息公示系统)
what: Look up any mainland company's registration, legal representative, shareholders, registered capital, annual reports, penalties and abnormal-operation listings by name or unified social credit code.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser. Heavy anti-bot captcha on every search; the commercial databases below repackage this data.

name: Credit China (信用中国)
what: Check a company's administrative licences, penalties and 'dishonest' or serious-violation blacklist entries collected from government agencies.
run_by: National Development and Reform Commission / National Public Credit Information Centre
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: Qichacha (企查查)
what: Search mainland and Hong Kong companies for shareholders, ultimate owners, executives, linked firms, lawsuits and historical changes, with ownership graphs.
note: Free login (Chinese phone number usually needed) for basic data; history, exports and deep ownership are paid. Data comes from official registers; check the source record.

name: Tianyancha (天眼查)
what: Map a company's shareholders, investments, key people, court cases, trademarks and historical registration changes.
run_by: Beijing Jindi Technology (北京金堤科技, private)
note: Returned an anti-bot error (419) to our checker; loads in a browser. Free login for basics, paid VIP for depth.

name: CNINFO (巨潮资讯网)
what: Read annual reports, prospectuses and announcements of companies listed in Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing, the official disclosure site named by the securities regulator.

name: Shanghai Stock Exchange (上海证券交易所)
what: Find listed-company disclosures, bond issuance documents, IPO review files and exchange disciplinary actions for Shanghai-listed firms.

name: Shenzhen Stock Exchange (深圳证券交易所)
what: Find disclosures, IPO filings, regulatory letters and disciplinary decisions for Shenzhen-listed companies.
note: Home page now redirects to szse.cn/index/index.html.

name: China Securities Regulatory Commission (中国证券监督管理委员会)
what: Read administrative penalty decisions, market bans and IPO registration decisions against companies and individuals in securities cases.

name: SASAC (国务院国有资产监督管理委员会)
what: Find the list of centrally owned state enterprises, their leadership appointments and policy documents on SOE reform.
run_by: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission

name: China Social Organisation Government Service Platform (中国社会组织政务服务平台)
what: Check whether a foundation, association or private non-enterprise unit is registered, its registration authority and any penalties.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: Overseas NGO Service Platform (境外非政府组织办事服务平台)
what: Check which foreign NGOs have registered representative offices or filed temporary activities in mainland China, and their supervising units.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: SEC EDGAR full-text search
what: Read annual reports (20-F) of US-listed Chinese companies, which describe VIE structures, risk factors, related parties and major shareholders.
note: Blocks scripts that do not declare a contact User-Agent; opens normally in a browser.

name: AidData Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset
what: Download project-level records of Chinese government loans and grants worldwide, with lenders, borrowers, amounts and sources.
note: This dataset covers 2000 to 2021. A newer companion, China's Global Loans and Grants Dataset 1.0 (2000 to 2023), was released in November 2025.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: US Consolidated Screening List
what: Search in one place the US export and sanctions lists (Entity List, SDN, Unverified List, Military End User List and others) for Chinese names.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: BIS Entity List (EAR Supplement 4 to Part 744)
what: Read the full Entity List with each Chinese entity's addresses, aliases, licence requirement and the Federal Register notice that added it.
run_by: US Bureau of Industry and Security
note: Old bis.doc.gov Entity List page now redirects to the bis.gov home page.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: OFAC Sanctions List Search
what: Search US Treasury sanctions lists, including the SDN and Non-SDN Chinese Military-Industrial Complex lists, by name, address or programme.
run_by: US Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: Section 1260H list of Chinese military companies (Federal Register notice)
what: Read the notice of the latest Pentagon list of companies it designates as Chinese military companies operating in the US.
run_by: US Department of Defense (Department of War) via the Federal Register
note: The June 2026 update listed 188 entities; WuXi AppTec was removed on 10 Nov 2026 after a court order, leaving 187. The list PDF is on media.defense.gov, which blocked our checker.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: UFLPA Entity List
what: See companies whose goods are presumed made with Uyghur forced labour and barred from US import, with the reason for each listing.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: OpenSanctions
what: Search sanctions, export-control and politically exposed person lists from many countries at once, including the 1260H list and Chinese countersanctions.
note: Free for journalists and non-commercial use; bulk commercial use is paid.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: UK Sanctions List
what: Download the UK's list of sanctioned people and entities, including Chinese firms designated over Russia and Xinjiang.
run_by: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: World Bank listing of ineligible firms
what: Check whether a Chinese contractor has been debarred from World Bank-financed projects, for how long and on what grounds.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: MOFCOM Unreliable Entity List announcements (商务部 部令公告)
what: Read Ministry of Commerce orders and announcements, including Unreliable Entity List designations of foreign companies.
run_by: Ministry of Commerce of the PRC
note: No consolidated list page; search the announcements for 不可靠实体清单. Some 2025 designations have been suspended under US-China trade arrangements; check for later suspension notices.

category: Sanctions, export controls and entity lists
name: China Export Control Information Network (中国出口管制信息网)
what: Read China's export-control control list (出口管制管控名单) decisions, rules on dual-use items and rare-earth and critical-mineral controls.
run_by: Ministry of Commerce of the PRC

name: China Judgements Online (中国裁判文书网)
what: Search published court judgments from courts across mainland China by party, case number, court or keyword.
note: Needs a mainland phone number to register. Since 2021 millions of rulings have been removed (death penalty, national security, most administrative cases) and uploads have fallen sharply; absence of a judgment proves nothing.

name: China Court Trial Online (中国庭审公开网)
what: Watch live and recorded video of selected court hearings and search past trial recordings by court or case type.

name: China Enforcement Information Disclosure (中国执行信息公开网)
what: Check whether a company is listed as a judgment debtor, a 'dishonest' debtor (失信被执行人) or under consumption restrictions.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser. Lists individuals as well as companies; treat personal entries with care.

name: People's Court Announcements (人民法院公告网)
what: Search court notices: service by publication, hearing dates, bankruptcy and auction notices, naming companies and parties.

name: National Enterprise Bankruptcy Information Disclosure Platform (全国企业破产重整案件信息网)
what: Track bankruptcy and restructuring cases, administrators, creditor meetings and court rulings for mainland companies.
note: Root now redirects to /pcajxxw/index/xxwsy.

name: People's Procuratorate Case Information (12309中国检察网)
what: Search indictments and prosecution decisions published by procuratorates nationwide.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser. Publication is selective.

name: National Database of Laws and Regulations (国家法律法规数据库)
what: Read the official text of national laws, administrative regulations, local regulations and judicial interpretations, including repealed laws (marked as such).

name: PKULaw (北大法宝)
what: Search laws, regulations, judgments and legal journals in one database, with English translations of key laws.
note: Limited free access; full text and English versions need a subscription.

name: China Law Translate
what: Read English translations of Chinese laws, regulations and policy documents, often within days of release.

name: CaseOpen
what: Search an independent snapshot of China Judgements Online rulings from 2013 to 2024, including some later removed from the official site.
note: Bot check blocks scripts; normally loads in a browser. Unsure who runs it; verify any judgment against other records. Its dataset is being imported into Chinese Wikisource.

name: Chinese Government Portal (中国政府网)
what: Read State Council decisions, appointments and removals, policy documents and official statistics releases.
run_by: General Office of the State Council

name: State Council policy documents (中国政府网 政策)
what: Search State Council and ministry policy documents, notices and interpretations by keyword and date.
run_by: General Office of the State Council
note: The deeper policy library (zhengceku) returned 403 to our checker.

name: English white papers (State Council Information Office)
what: Read the government's English white papers on defence, Xinjiang, Tibet, Hong Kong and other subjects.

name: National People's Congress (中国人大网)
what: Read draft laws open for comment, Standing Committee session records and NPC deputy lists.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: CCDI / National Supervisory Commission (中央纪委国家监委网站)
what: Read announcements of investigations, expulsions and punishments of officials and SOE managers, and inspection-tour reports.
note: Served a captcha page to our checker; loads in a browser, sometimes slowly outside China.

name: Xinhua central leadership pages (新华网 中央领导机构)
what: Read official biographies of members of the Politburo, Central Committee and other central leadership bodies.

name: Communist Party Member Network (共产党员网)
what: Read Party regulations, Organisation Department notices and official cadre appointment announcements.
run_by: Organisation Department of the CCP Central Committee

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (外交部)
what: Read transcripts of daily press conferences, statements and countersanction announcements.
run_by: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC

name: United Front Work Department (中共中央统一战线工作部)
what: Read announcements on the department's work with overseas Chinese, religious groups, ethnic minorities and non-Party figures.

name: Ministry of Finance (财政部)
what: Download central and consolidated budgets, final accounts and local government debt figures.
run_by: Ministry of Finance of the PRC

name: Cyberspace Administration of China (中央网信办)
what: Read internet regulations, algorithm and generative-AI filing lists, and enforcement campaigns against platforms.

name: China Government Procurement Network (中国政府采购网)
what: Search central and local government procurement notices, award announcements and contracts by keyword, buyer and region.

name: National Public Resources Trading Platform (全国公共资源交易平台)
what: Search tenders and results for public works, land, mining rights and state assets across provinces.

name: China Tendering and Bidding Public Service Platform (中国招标投标公共服务平台)
what: Search construction and engineering tender notices and award results, including for SOEs.
run_by: China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing
note: Returned 405 to our checker; Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: Central Government Procurement (中央政府采购网)
what: See framework agreements and purchases by central state bodies through the central procurement centre.
note: Redirected but returned no page content to our checker; often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: All-Army Weapons and Equipment Procurement Information Network (全军武器装备采购信息网)
what: See PLA equipment procurement demand notices, supplier registration rules and policy, launched in 2015.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser. Most detail needs a registered supplier account.

name: Military Procurement Network (军队采购网)
what: Search PLA procurement notices and award announcements for goods, services and construction.
run_by: Central Military Commission Logistic Support Department (as described in official notices)
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser. Earlier address was plap.cn; the .mil.cn address was not confirmed by an official page.

name: State Grid e-commerce platform (国家电网新一代电子商务平台)
what: Search tender and award notices of State Grid, China's largest SOE and a major buyer of equipment.

name: CNIPA patent search (专利检索及分析系统)
what: Search Chinese patent applications and grants, with applicants, inventors, claims and legal status.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: China Trademark Office search (中国商标网 商标查询)
what: Look up trademark registrations and applicants, useful for linking brands to companies.
note: Old /sbj/sbcx/ path now redirects here.

name: Google Patents
what: Search Chinese patents with machine translation into English, with citations and assignee links.

name: Espacenet
what: Search worldwide patents, including Chinese filings, and see patent families across countries.
note: Bot check blocks scripts; normally loads in a browser.

name: The Lens
what: Link patents and scholarly papers by Chinese institutions and see who cites whom.
note: Free for public use; some features need a free login.

name: CNKI (中国知网)
what: Search Chinese journals, dissertations, conference papers, newspapers and yearbooks, often the only source for PLA-affiliated research.
run_by: Tongfang Knowledge Network (同方知网), part of Tongfang Co., controlled by China National Nuclear Corporation since 2025
note: Redirects to oversea.cnki.net from outside China. Abstracts are free; full text needs a subscription. Since 2023 some databases are closed to overseas users.

name: Wanfang Data (万方数据)
what: Search Chinese journals, dissertations, standards, patents and local gazetteers.

name: NSFC grant search (国家自然科学基金 大数据知识管理服务门户)
what: Look up National Natural Science Foundation grants by researcher, institution and topic, with funding amounts.
run_by: National Natural Science Foundation of China
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: OpenAlex
what: Find papers by Chinese institutions and their co-authors abroad, and map research links by institution.

name: China Land Market Network (中国土地市场网)
what: Search land-use rights sales and allocations, with plot location, use, price and buyer.
note: Blocked our checker ('访问被拦截'); Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: Ministry of Natural Resources (自然资源部)
what: Find land, mineral and marine policy, mining rights notices and land-use enforcement cases.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: IPE Blue Map (蔚蓝地图)
what: Check a factory's or company's environmental violation records, pollution data and supplier links.
run_by: Institute of Public and Environmental Affairs (NGO, Beijing)

name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (生态环境部)
what: Find environmental impact assessment approvals, inspection-team reports and enforcement cases.

name: National Pollutant Discharge Permit Platform (全国排污许可证管理信息平台)
what: Look up a facility's discharge permit, permitted pollutants and limits by company name.

name: National Urban Air Quality Real-time Publishing Platform (全国城市空气质量实时发布平台)
what: See hourly official air quality readings by city and monitoring station.

name: National Water and Rain Information (全国水雨情信息)
what: See river and reservoir levels and rainfall at major stations, useful during floods and dam stories.

name: Global Energy Monitor
what: Track Chinese coal, gas, steel and power plants, at home and abroad, with owners, capacity and status.
note: Its wiki (gem.wiki) blocked our checker.

name: China Energy Portal
what: Read English translations of Chinese energy statistics and policy documents.
note: Root now redirects to /en/.

name: Tianditu (天地图)
what: View the official national map and imagery with Chinese place names and administrative boundaries.
note: Blocked our checker; Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser. Free login for the API.

name: Baidu Maps (百度地图)
what: Find Chinese businesses, addresses and street-level panoramas.
note: Uses BD-09 coordinates, offset from GPS (WGS-84) by hundreds of metres; convert before comparing.

name: Amap (高德地图)
what: Find points of interest, addresses and satellite views across China.
note: Uses GCJ-02 coordinates, offset from GPS; convert before comparing.

name: Standard Map Service (标准地图服务)
what: Download official maps showing China's claimed boundaries as approved for publication.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: Copernicus Browser
what: View and download free Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery of any place in China every few days.
note: Free login for downloads and time-lapses.

name: NASA FIRMS
what: Map fire and heat detections, including industrial heat sources such as steel plants.

name: Esri World Imagery Wayback
what: Compare earlier versions of Esri's high-resolution basemap to date construction at a site.

name: Google Earth
what: View high-resolution imagery, including historical imagery for dating changes (on the web version since 2024).

name: OpenStreetMap
what: Check mapped roads, buildings and facilities in WGS-84 coordinates, without the Chinese offset.

name: Coordinate converter (地图坐标系转换)
what: Convert between GPS (WGS-84), GCJ-02 and Baidu BD-09 coordinates.

name: Ministry of National Defense (国防部)
what: Read regular press conferences (several a month), white papers and statements on exercises and foreign military contacts.
run_by: Ministry of National Defense of the PRC

name: China Military Online (中国军网)
what: Read PLA Daily and other official military news, which name units, commanders and exercises.

name: China Aerospace Studies Institute (CASI)
what: Download studies and translated PLA texts on the air force, rocket force and space programme, including organisational charts.
note: Returned 403 to our checker; opens in a browser.

name: ASPI China Defence Universities Tracker
what: Check a Chinese university's links to the military, security agencies and defence industry, with risk ratings.
note: Bot check blocks scripts; normally loads in a browser.

name: ASPI Critical Technology Tracker
what: Compare countries' research output in critical technologies and see leading Chinese institutions.
note: Bot check blocks scripts; normally loads in a browser.

name: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database
what: Find Chinese arms exports and imports by weapon, buyer and year since 1950.

name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
what: Compare SIPRI's estimates of Chinese military spending with the official budget.

name: Japan Joint Staff press releases (統合幕僚監部 報道発表資料)
what: Read Japan's reports of Chinese warships, aircraft and drones near Japan, often with photos and hull numbers.
run_by: Japan Ministry of Defense, Joint Staff

name: Taiwan MND PLA Activities
what: Read daily counts and flight-path maps of PLA aircraft and ships around Taiwan.
note: Figures are Taiwan's own claims.

name: CNA China studies
what: Read research on PLA organisation, maritime militia and Chinese security policy.

name: MarineTraffic
what: Track ships by AIS, including Chinese research vessels, coast guard ships and fishing fleets.
note: History and satellite AIS are paid. Chinese vessels often switch AIS off or spoof it.

name: Global Fishing Watch map
what: Map fishing activity and AIS gaps of Chinese distant-water fleets, and see vessels detected by satellite radar.
note: Now redirects to /platform/map. A free login is needed only to save workspaces and download reports.

name: Equasis
what: Look up a ship's owner, manager, flag history, classification society and inspection record by IMO number.

name: IMO GISIS
what: Check registered owners and company IMO numbers behind a ship.

name: China Maritime Safety Administration (中国海事局)
what: Read navigation warnings (航行警告) that close sea areas for live-fire drills, rocket debris and research operations.

name: China Coast Guard (中国海警局)
what: Read official statements on patrols around disputed islands and enforcement actions.
run_by: China Coast Guard (under the People's Armed Police)

name: CSIS Asia Maritime Transparency Initiative
what: See satellite imagery and analysis of Chinese island-building, outposts and maritime militia in the South China Sea.
run_by: Center for Strategic and International Studies

name: Flightradar24
what: Track and replay commercial flights in and out of China.
note: Coverage inside mainland China is patchy.

name: ADS-B Exchange
what: Track aircraft without filtering of military or blocked aircraft, including surveillance flights near China.

name: China National Space Administration (国家航天局)
what: Read official announcements on Chinese lunar, Mars and satellite missions.

name: Space-Track
what: Download orbital data for Chinese satellites and rocket bodies, including debris re-entries.

name: Jonathan's Space Report
what: Check catalogues of every launch and satellite, including classified Chinese payloads.

name: National Bureau of Statistics (国家统计局)
what: Read monthly economic releases, census results and statistical communiqués.

name: National Data (国家数据)
what: Query monthly, quarterly and annual national and provincial statistical series.
note: Root now redirects to a new interface (/dg/website/page.html).

name: China Statistical Yearbook (中国统计年鉴)
what: Download annual statistical yearbooks with tables on population, economy and society.

name: China Customs statistics (海关统计数据在线查询平台)
what: Query Chinese imports and exports by product code, partner country and month.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: UN Comtrade
what: Compare Chinese trade data with what partner countries report, to spot mismatches.
note: Basic queries open; bulk downloads need a free account.

name: People's Bank of China (中国人民银行)
what: Download monetary, credit and balance-of-payments statistics and administrative penalties against payment firms.

name: China Data Lab
what: Find curated Chinese datasets and maps for research, from census tables to geographic boundaries.

name: Ministry of Civil Affairs administrative divisions (行政区划)
what: Look up official administrative division names and codes, needed to match places across datasets.
note: Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Weibo search (微博搜索)
what: Search public Weibo posts and trending topics by keyword and date.
note: Redirects to a visitor check; login needed for full results and older posts. Posts are often deleted quickly.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Sogou WeChat search (搜狗微信搜索)
what: Search articles from WeChat public accounts, the main channel for official and corporate announcements.
note: Captcha after a few searches; results are incomplete.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Douyin (抖音)
what: Search short videos posted inside China, often the first footage of local incidents.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Bilibili (哔哩哔哩)
what: Search video uploads, including military enthusiast channels and lectures.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Xiaohongshu / RedNote (小红书)
what: Search lifestyle posts and photos that often show places, products and events.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Baidu (百度)
what: Search the Chinese web, including local government pages that Google indexes poorly.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Baidu Index (百度指数)
what: See search-interest trends for a term over time and by province.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: China Digital Times
what: Read leaked censorship directives, banned-keyword lists, translations of deleted posts and, on its Chinese site, an archive of deleted articles.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: GreatFire
what: Find data on blocked websites, keywords and apps in China, gathered by continuous testing.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: GreatFire Analyzer
what: Test whether a given website or URL is blocked in mainland China and see its history.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: AppleCensorship
what: Check whether an app is unavailable in Apple's China App Store compared with other countries.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Citizen Lab
what: Read technical investigations into Chinese censorship in apps, spyware and keyword filtering.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: China Media Project
what: Read analysis of Party media language, propaganda campaigns and a dictionary of political terms.

category: Media, social platforms and censorship tracking
name: Xinhua (新华网)

what: Read bills, meeting records, members' interests and committee papers.

name: Hong Kong Government Gazette
what: Read official notices: appointments, company deregistrations, bankruptcies and legal notices.
note: gld.gov.hk/egazette/ now redirects here.

name: Macau Official Gazette (Boletim Oficial / 澳門特別行政區公報)
what: Read Macau laws, appointments and Series III notices of company incorporations and changes.
note: Timed out from our checker; PDFs are confirmed at images.io.gov.mo. Often slow or blocked from outside China; try a browser.

name: Macau Courts (澳門特別行政區法院)
what: Search judgments of Macau's courts in Chinese and Portuguese.
note: Root now redirects to /zh/.

name: Macau Gaming Inspection and Coordination Bureau (博彩監察協調局)
what: Find casino concessionaires, licensed promoters and gaming revenue statistics.

name: Macau Statistics and Census Service (統計暨普查局)
what: Download Macau economic, tourism and population statistics.
note: Root now redirects to /zh-MO/.

name: China Unofficial Archives (中国民间档案馆)
what: Find preserved citizen archives and reports, including copies of China Labour Bulletin's reports saved after it closed in 2025.
note: The documents themselves are on minjian-danganguan.org; the Substack carries the editors' notes.

name: Wayback Machine
what: See earlier versions of Chinese government and company pages, and save pages before they vanish.
note: Many .gov.cn pages block its crawler; save manually.

name: archive.today
what: Save a snapshot of a page, including some that the Wayback Machine cannot capture.
note: Timed out from our checker; URL from prior knowledge.

name: Wilson Center Digital Archive
what: Read declassified and translated Chinese and Soviet bloc documents on Cold War history.
note: Timed out twice from our checker.

name: CCTV Xinwen Lianbo and programme archive
what: Watch past episodes of CCTV programmes to check what was broadcast and when.

name: Pleco
what: Look up Chinese characters by drawing or camera, with several dictionaries.

name: MDBG Chinese Dictionary
what: Look up words and names in a free online Chinese-English dictionary.

name: Google Translate
what: Translate text, documents and photos of Chinese signs.

name: Baidu Baike (百度百科)
what: Find background on Chinese companies, places and official bios; edited by users and censored.

name: Baidu Image Search (百度图片)
what: Run reverse image searches that find Chinese-hosted copies of a photo.
